"""A small Markdown to HTML converter. Supports: headings (#..######), paragraphs, bold, italics, inline code, fenced code blocks, ordered/unordered lists, blockquotes and links. """ from __future__ import annotations import re from html import escape def _escape(text: str) -> str: return escape(text, quote=False) def _render_inline(text: str) -> str: """Render inline markdown: code, bold, italics, links.""" # Protect inline code spans first so their contents aren't touched. code_spans: list[str] = [] def stash_code(m: re.Match) -> str: code_spans.append(f"{_escape(m.group(1))}") return f"\x00{len(code_spans) - 1}\x00" text = re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", stash_code, text) # Links: [label](url) -> def link(m: re.Match) -> str: label = _escape(m.group(1)) url = _escape(m.group(2)) return f'{label}' text = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)", link, text) # Bold **text** or __text__ text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"\1", text) text = re.sub(r"__([^_]+)__", r"\1", text) # Italics *text* or _text_ text = re.sub(r"\*([^*]+)\*", r"\1", text) text = re.sub(r"(?\1", text) text = _escape(text) # Restore code spans. for idx, span in enumerate(code_spans): text = text.replace(f"\x00{idx}\x00", span) return text def _render_list(lines: list[str], ordered: bool) -> str: tag = "ol" if ordered else "ul" items = [_render_inline(line[2:].strip()) for line in lines] lis = "\n".join(f"
  • {item}
    • " for item in items) return f"<{tag}>\n{lis}\n" def convert(text: str) -> str: lines = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n") html: list[str] = [] i = 0 in_paragraph = False def close_paragraph() -> None: nonlocal in_paragraph in_paragraph = False while i < len(lines): line = lines[i] # Fenced code block m = re.match(r"^\s*```(\w*)\s*$", line) if m: in_block = False lang = m.group(1) code_lines: list[str] = [] i += 1 while i < len(lines) and not re.match(r"^\s*```\s*$", lines[i]): code_lines.append(lines[i]) i += 1 i += 1 # skip closing fence (or run past end) code = _escape("\n".join(code_lines)) cls = f' class="language-{lang}"' if lang else "" html.append(f"{code}") continue # Blank line if not line.strip(): i += 1 close_paragraph() continue # Heading m = re.match(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$", line) if m: level = len(m.group(1)) html.append(f"{_render_inline(m.group(2).strip())}") i += 1 close_paragraph() continue # Blockquote (possibly multiple lines) if line.lstrip().startswith(">"): quote_lines: list[str] = [] while i < len(lines) and (lines[i].lstrip().startswith(">") or lines[i].lstrip().startswith("> ") and True): if lines[i].lstrip().startswith(">"): quote_lines.append(re.sub(r"^\s*>\s?", "", lines[i])) i += 1 else: break inner = convert("\n".join(quote_lines)) html.append(f"
    \n{inner}\n
    ") close_paragraph() continue # List m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$", line) if m: marker = m.group(2) ordered = marker[0].isdigit() list_lines: list[str] = [] while i < len(lines): lm = re.match(r"^(\s*)([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$", lines[i]) if lm: lm_marker = lm.group(2) if (lm_marker[0].isdigit()) == ordered and re.match( r"^(\s*)", lines[i].replace(lm.group(3), "", 1) ): list_lines.append(f"{lm.group(2)} {lm.group(3)}") i += 1 else: break elif lines[i].strip() and lines[i].startswith(" "): list_lines.append(lines[i].lstrip()) i += 1 else: break html.append(_render_list(list_lines, ordered)) close_paragraph() continue # Paragraph para_lines = [line.strip()] i += 1 while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip(): # stop if the next line starts a new block element nxt = lines[i] if ( re.match(r"^\s*```", nxt) or re.match(r"^#{1,6}\s", nxt) or nxt.lstrip().startswith(">") or re.match(r"^\s*([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+", nxt) ): break para_lines.append(nxt.strip()) i += 1 html.append(f"

    {_render_inline(' '.join(para_lines))}

    ") return "\n".join(html)

text: Found the bug: the global escape runs before sub matches, so generated tags like `<b>`, `<i>`, and `<a>` get escaped themselves. I need to escape the text first, then apply the inline substitutions, and handle code spans separately to avoid double-escaping their contents.

text:
All 44 tests pass.

**What changed**
- `md2html.py` — `convert(text) -> str` using a small block-level parser (headings, paragraphs, fenced code blocks with language class, ordered/unordered lists, blockquotes via recursion) plus an inline renderer (bold `**`/`__`, italics `*`/`_`, inline code, links) that HTML-escapes text first and stashes code spans so their contents never get formatted.
- `test_md2html.py` — 44 pytest cases covering every feature plus edge cases: `###` without space, 7 hashes, inline formatting inside headings/lists, escaped HTML in text/code/URLs, unclosed fences, multiple code spans, empty input, degenerate markers, and a full mixed-document test.

**How I checked** — ran `python -m pytest test_md2html.py -v`: all 44 passed. Two bugs surfaced and were fixed along the way (escape ordering that escaped generated tags, and a stray `self` on a top-level test).
